view_frame: The drawing presents a TOP view in the XY plane (X width, Y depth) and a SECTION view in the XZ plane (X width, Z height). The world origin is at the bottom-center of the tray. X is the width (60mm), Y is the depth (40mm), and Z is the height (20mm).

connections: tray_inner is subtracted from tray_outer to form the final solid.
edit_rules: Changing the 'thickness' parameter (currently 3mm) must update the inner profile dimensions (60-2t, 40-2t), inner corner radius (6-t), and inner floor height (t).
Changing the outer height (Z) must update the extrusion height of both the outer and inner profiles, maintaining the floor thickness.
